expected.reason: CSRF token mismatch (419 Page Expired). Laravel form POST returned 302 (POST-Redirect-Get) during recording but 419 during replay. Root cause: SESSION_DRIVER=file (default) — sessions are stored as files which are NOT restored by the DB checkpoint. Laravel cannot find the session → rejects the CSRF token.
expected.recommendation: Add SESSION_DRIVER=database to your app's environment in docker-compose.yml. Sessions will then be stored in MySQL and restored by checkpoint.sh. Re-record after applying this change.
